product.title: In your stores
product.empty: This product isn't listed in a connected store.

listings.emptyBody: Once a store is connected, its products will be here, each with the product or variation it sells.

errors.STORE_ADDRESS_INVALID: That isn't the store's own address. Use the one ending in myshopify.com.
errors.STORE_CREDENTIALS_REFUSED: The store didn't accept the client ID and secret.
errors.STORE_SCOPES_MISSING: The store's app is missing permissions Hoard needs: {{detail}}.
errors.STORE_UNREACHABLE: The store couldn't be reached. Try saving the connection again in a moment.
errors.STORE_SUBSCRIPTION_REFUSED: The store didn't let Hoard hear about its orders and products.
errors.CHANNEL_UNSUPPORTED: Hoard can't connect to this kind of store yet.
